propertySets.name: Pset_CableCarrierSegmentTypeCableTraySegment
propertySets.definition:
An (typically) open carrier segment onto which cables are laid.
HISTORY: IFC4 - NominalLength deleted. To be handled as a quantity measure

properties.name: HasCover
properties.definition: Indication of whether the cable tray has a cover (=TRUE) or not (= FALSE). By default, this value should be set to FALSE..
